description_full: Elemental Royalty Corporation engages in the acquisition and generation of precious and base metal royalties. It is also involved in exploration royalties and royalty generation assets. The company holds royalties in gold, silver, copper, and precious metal projects. In addition, it operates in North America; South America; Australia; Africa; and internationally. The company was formerly known as Elemental Altus Royalties Corp. and changed its name to Elemental Royalty Corporation in November 2025. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation is a small-cap basic materials business with a $1.2B market cap on $44M of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 0% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 63% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $31M in free cash flow — roughly 71 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 17.39× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 11.0×.

Net dilution runs at 7.4% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 38% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
